text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
On our way back from a day out,<n>Super Creek and I
are talking about<n>getting tea together when...

text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Spending a lazy day with your<n>Umamusume? Talk
about taking it<n>easy.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Um... And you are?

text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer
text_block_list.text: I'm a trainer at Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Goodness, is that so? Then that must<n>make the two
of you acquai—

text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer
text_block_list.text:
That's neither here nor there.<n>Shouldn't you be
taking better care of<n>your Umamusume?

text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer
text_block_list.text:
These first three years of the Twinkle<n>Series are
the most important to an<n>Umamusume, right?

text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I'm pretty sure you don't have the<n>time to be
slacking off like this.

text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer
text_block_list.text: The girls may need breaks, but do<n>trainers?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Of course they do. A trainer would<n>collapse if they
worked non-stop.<n>Besides...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
My trainer is very considerate of me.<n>You don't
need to worry about us.

text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer
text_block_list.text:
That kind of complacent mindset<n>leaves no room for
an Umamusume<n>to grow.
choice_data_list: I have clear and detailed plans.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, that's right—because you're<n>an amazing
person.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You're always studying so much so<n>you can do
well to guide me.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: You're a wonderful trainer. ♪

text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...I see. It's none of my business, I<n>suppose. If
you'll excuse me...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: The other trainer storms off in a huff.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...Hey. Don't let what that other<n>trainer said get to
you.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: We're moving along at our own pace.<n>Besides...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Maybe she had something troubling<n>her. She
sounded... really lonely.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I wouldn't give it much thought.
choice_data_list: It's okay. It doesn't bother me.
It's okay. It doesn't bother me.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Glad to hear that. Okay, let's relax<n>with a cup of tea
before heading<n>back! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And with that, Super Creek spends<n>the rest of the
day walking right by<n>my side as if to comfort me.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: My trainer knows me better than I<n>know myself.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
And all that knowledge and<n>experience helps me
one way or<n>another.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
So while I appreciate the concern,<n>there's really
nothing for you to<n>worry about.

text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Well, if the day ever comes<n>that you regret
those words, don't<n>come crying to me.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: The other trainer storms off in a huff.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? Are you thinking about what<n>that other
trainer said to you?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I thought so...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Instead of thinking about what she<n>said, I hope you
can take my words<n>to heart.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: You're always helping me.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes, when I'm supposed to<n>be spoiling you,
I feel like I'm the one<n>who ends up being spoiled.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: So you should believe in yourself.<n>Okay?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And with that, Super Creek spends<n>the rest of the
day walking right by<n>my side as if to comfort me.
